text:
Predicates:
Player(x) ::: x is a football player.
Loan(x, y) ::: x was loaned out to football club y.
Club(x) ::: x is a football club.
PlaysFor(x, y) ::: x plays for football club y.
SameClub(x, y) ::: x is a football club along with y.

Premises:
Player(ailtonSilva) ∧ Born(ailtonSilva, 1995) ∧ LoanedOut(ailtonSilva, braga) ::: Ailton Silva, born in 1995, is commonly known as Ailton and was loaned out to Braga.
Player(ailtonSilva) ∧ PlaysFor(ailtonSilva, nautico) ∧ Club(nautico) ∧ Club(braga) ∧ SameClub(nautico, braga) ::: Ailton is a football player who plays for Nautico. Ailton Silva is a Brazilian footballer who plays for Nautico. Nautico is a football club along with Braga.
Club(fluminense) ::: Fluminense is a football club.

Conclusion:
Loan(ailtonSilva, footballClub) ::: Ailton Silva was loaned out to a football club.
